title: 2D semiconductor aims to turbocharge development of high-performance electronics
abstract: Nature, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02777-x An ultrathin semiconductor that conducts electricity using positively charged ‘holes’ might clear the way for next-generation electronic devices.

title: Wafer-scale epitaxy growth of high-mobility p-type boron carbon nitride
abstract: Nature, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11047-9 A dual-precursor chemical system is used to achieve wafer-scale epitaxy growth of boron carbon nitride, a high-performance p-type semiconductor, for potential integration in efficient 2D materials for electronics.

title: Transcription pause and elongation regulators mediate somatic hypermutation
abstract: Nature, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11092-4 The molecular factors and mechanisms that mediate the chromatin recruitment of activation-induced deaminase and the generation of its stalled polymerase II substrate during somatic hypermutation are identified.

title: Lab-grown brain organoids: time for international oversight
abstract: Nature, Published online: 29 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03048-5 Researchers in the field are right to focus on biosafety, ethics and the involvement of patient groups and the public.

title: Briefing Chat: Why scientists made papyrus scrolls, then burnt them
abstract: Nature, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03041-y Nature staff discuss a technique that could help researchers read charred Herculaneum scrolls — plus, a biodegradeable, edible battery.
